title: Record reading
purpose: Record one temperature reading of a tank, freezer or other equipment, kept with the limits set on it now.
summary: Record one temperature reading of a tank, freezer or other equipment, kept with the limits set on it now.

tasks.title: Record a reading
steps: Choose the [[Equipment]] read, not the monitor.
Enter [[Read at]] and the [[Temperature]] in °C, and the [[Probe position]] if known.

tasks.title: Record many readings
steps: Upload a CSV from Readings imports instead.

good_to_know: The limits set on the equipment now are saved with the reading.
Vapor-phase temperature varies with height, so the probe position matters.
Temperatures keep up to two decimals, exactly as typed.

sections.title: Who can use it and when
paragraphs: Technicians, managers and administrators. Viewers are refused. Equipment that is retired, and temperature monitors, are not offered: record the reading against the tank or freezer the monitor watches and name the monitor in the Monitor field. When the action is not possible right now, the form opens with a Not available notice that gives the reason, its fields are disabled and there is no submit button; Cancel returns to the record. The checks are repeated on the server when you save, so a form that opens is not a guarantee.
Times are repository local time, to the second, and cannot be in the future.

items.label: Equipment
items.description: Required. The tank or freezer read, not the monitor. A preselected value comes from the record or filtered list you came from, and its limits are quoted beside the form.

items.label: Read at
items.description: Required. When the temperature was read; defaults to now.

items.label: Temperature
items.description: Required, in °C, with up to two decimals, not below absolute zero (-273.15).

items.label: Probe position
items.description: Optional, up to 80 characters: where it was read, as stated, for example top of rack or display. Vapor-phase temperature varies with height, so record it when it matters.

items.label: Monitor
items.description: Optional: the registered temperature monitor that produced the value.

items.label: Note
items.description: Optional, up to 4,000 characters. Do not enter donor, patient or participant names or other text that could identify a person.

sections.title: Rules
paragraphs: The limits set on the equipment at this moment are stored with the reading, and the success message says when the reading is outside them. A reading at the same time and probe position as one already recorded for that equipment is refused as a duplicate: correct the existing one instead.
Record reading adds the reading and an audit event together and returns to the readings list for that equipment. A reading cannot be edited; use Correct.
